name: standmeet-retrieval-mcp
description: retrieval block (JS, cross-platform — replaces the former Go binary): a stdio-MCP server exposing 8 corpus read tools that forward to the host over STANDMEET_HOST_SOCKET (search/read/list/links/map/resolve/peek/grep), carrying the opaque frozen corpus-ACL scope. Owns no data. As JS it cannot import host/Go internals — host-blindness is structural.
